name: Companion Expedition Loop
description: A companion-led exploration recipe: an equipped pet selects an undiscovered POI, a bounded scent trail communicates its bearing, arrival discovers the place, and the discovery builds bond and an idempotent collection log. The POI network remains authoritative for discovery; the trail never reveals content or supplies navigation.

components.role: authoritative POI registry and discovery state
per-profile discovery history and set completion

connections.note: The equipped pet supplies species tracking tags.
Bond tier changes update the valid search radius.
Only an acquired target produces a trail.
A lost target clears the presentation.
Reaching the target ends the hint without granting discovery itself.
Discovered POIs leave the candidate pool.
Authoritative discovery clears any matching trail.
Shared discovery strengthens the equipped companion bond.
Only the POI network can advance expedition history.
The idempotent discovery record is saved.

acceptanceCriteria: An equipped pet selects only an undiscovered, tag-compatible POI within its bond-tier range, with distance and POI-id tie-breaking.
Scent presentation follows the selected target but never reveals the POI or claims a walkable navigation path.
Only world.point_of_interest_network can transition a POI to discovered and thereby advance the expedition loop.
A discovery strengthens the equipped pet's bond and is recorded exactly once per profile, including across duplicate events and reloads.
Unequipping the pet, losing the target, or discovering the target clears its trail.
Bond tiers and discovery progress are included in persistence state.
